boundary_rule: Includes strategically relevant novelty not ordinary activity relabeling
Includes outcomes and durable changes not only outputs or reach
Includes robustness recovery adaptation and transformation but requires specifying which
Includes coherence around goals logic constraints and decision rules not mere agreement
Includes structural change not ordinary improvement or rebranding
Includes ecological social institutional and temporal durability with explicit tradeoffs
Includes credibility reliability procedural fairness and institutional memory
Includes resource effectiveness but excludes burden shifting disguised as savings
Includes economic social knowledge legitimacy and systems value when relevant
Includes meaningful influence not symbolic consultation
